name: search_photos
description: Search Unsplash photos by keyword (required); returns paginated results with image URLs, dimensions, photographer info, and alt text.

name: photo
description: Fetch full metadata for a single Unsplash photo by id, including all image URLs (raw, full, regular, small, thumb), EXIF, location, tags, and photographer.

name: photo_random
description: Retrieve one or more random Unsplash photos; supports optional filters (query, orientation, collections, topics, username, content_filter) passed as extra params.

name: photo_download
description: Trigger the Unsplash required download-tracking event for a photo by id and return the download URL; must be called before presenting the download link to users per Unsplash API guidelines.

name: photo_statistics
description: Fetch view, download, and like statistics for a single Unsplash photo by id; supports resolution ("days") and quantity (1–30) to control the time-series window.

name: list_photos
description: Fetch Unsplash's public editorial feed of recently curated photos in chronological or popular order; returns paginated photo objects with URLs and metadata.

name: user
description: Fetch the public Unsplash profile for a given username, including bio, location, follower/following counts, total photos/likes/collections, and portfolio URL.

name: user_photos
description: List photos uploaded by a specific Unsplash username; returns paginated photo objects with image URLs, likes, and metadata.

name: user_likes
description: List photos that a specific Unsplash username has liked; returns paginated photo objects with image URLs, photographer, and metadata.

name: collections
description: List featured Unsplash collections in paginated order; returns collection id, title, description, total photos, cover photo, and curator info.

name: collection
description: Fetch metadata for a single Unsplash collection by id, including title, description, total photos, tags, cover photo, and curator profile.

name: collection_photos
description: List photos inside a specific Unsplash collection by id; returns paginated photo objects with image URLs and metadata.

name: topics
description: List Unsplash editorial topics (curated content channels like "nature", "architecture"); returns topic id, slug, title, description, cover photo, and curator.

name: topic
description: Fetch metadata for a single Unsplash topic by id or slug (e.g. "animals"), including title, description, total photos, cover photo, and top contributors.

name: topic_photos
description: List photos belonging to a specific Unsplash topic by id or slug; returns paginated photo objects with image URLs, EXIF, and photographer info.
